Maya (CS): Heads-up — Skylark Health renewal in ~5 weeks. Spike down ~62% last 28d. Seats 14->5. Champion Priya promoted. Need a short playbook.

Rafael (CSM): Yikes. Any sign of errors or a competitor run?

Maya (CS): No errors. Procurement confirmed a short eval with EchoAI last week. They requested a summarization comparison.

Olga (RevOps): Billing shows embedding units -59% and generation tokens -47%. No unpaid invoices.

Neil (Eng): I can prepare a compact bake-off harness and a reproducible dataset (500 docs). Will include quality metrics: precision@5 and avg cosine gap.

Maya (CS): Support ticket mentioned "found cheaper embeddings elsewhere".

Rafael (CSM): Plan: (1) 10-day Dedicated-lite trial; (2) bake-off with objective metrics; (3) short retention offer if we win (enablement credit + pricing concession). Who owns what?

Olga (RevOps): I can draft the concession: 30% off embedding units for trial + $8k enablement credit on 12mo conversion. Need finance OK.

Neil (Eng): I'll push bench scripts and a README. Snippet I will share:
```
python tools/bench.py --dataset skylark_500.json --model rwd-embed-small --batch 64
```
I will post results to /shared/skylark/bakeoff.

Maya (CS): Rafael, please invite new stakeholders: Jae (Head of Data), Lynn (Procurement). Schedule kickoff Tue 9am PT.

ci-bot: Trial instance provisioned: skylark-dedicated-01 (expires in 10 days).

Rafael (CSM): Invite sent. Attaching success metrics: precision@5 >= 0.76, 95th pct latency <= 140ms.

Maya (CS): Great. We'll reconvene after bake-off to decide retention package.

Olga (RevOps): Drafted terms, sharing in thread — will loop in finance.
